scripts.admin:dev: bun run --cwd packages/electron bundle && OP_HOME=/tmp/openpalm-admin-dev OPENPALM_REPO_ROOT="$PWD" bun run --cwd packages/electron start
scripts._dev:stack:note: The dev shortcut mirrors the two-file runtime: one managed stack plus the user overlay.
scripts.test: bun run lib:test && bun run guardian:test && bun run cli:test && bun run --cwd packages/claude-desktop test && bun run --cwd packages/electron test && bun test --isolate packages/portal/src/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run --cwd packages/lib typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/guardian typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/portal typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/cli typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/electron typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/claude-desktop typecheck
scripts.lint: biome lint package.json .github/release-manifest.json packages scripts/*.mjs scripts/*.ts containers/assistant/*.mjs
scripts.format: biome format --write package.json .github/release-manifest.json packages scripts/*.mjs scripts/*.ts containers/assistant/*.mjs
